shots.say: Leo found a strange old book in the attic. The moment he opened it... the story leapt right off the page.
Every night, the Moon's gravity tugs on Earth's oceans, pulling the water into a bulge that follows the Moon around the planet.
Wherever that bulge passes, the sea climbs up the shore. That's high tide.
But what if the Moon... just vanished?
The bulge would flatten. Tides would shrink to about a third. And without the Moon to steady it, Earth's tilt could start to wobble.
So tonight, look up and say thanks. The Moon is quietly holding our world together.
